op.split.many_parts_hint.en: Splitting into many parts can take a while on dense meshes...

op.split.autocap.none.en: Auto-cap during split did not find valid loops to fill.

op.cap_now.desc.en: Fill between exactly two split edge loops (outer+inner) per plane. Seeds preferred.

op.cap_now.max_planes.desc.en: 0 = all planes per object, 1 = only largest

op.cap_now.require_two_seeds.desc.en: If exactly two edges are selected in Edit Mode, use them as seeds only (no auto-detection).

op.cap_now.no_targets.en: No mesh objects to cap. Select split parts or use the parts collection.

op.cap_now.none_selected.en: Could not determine split edge loops to select.

op.cap_now.none_capped.en: Could not determine and fill split edge loops.

op.cap_now.selected_count.en: Selected split edge loops on {n} object(s).

warn.apply_transforms_hint.en: Consider Apply All Transforms (Ctrl+A) for exact and predictable split results.

ui.split_offset_desc.en: Offset of the cutting plane along the split axis (positive in axis direction)

ui.show_split_preview_desc.en: Show temporary orange planes at planned cut positions

ui.parts_count_desc.en: Number of desired segments (cut planes = parts - 1)

ui.cap_seams_during_split_desc.en: Automatically close seams after splitting. With hollow/inner shell: precise outer/inner loop fill; without hollow: simple fill. May increase runtime.

ui.snap_dovetail_desc.en: Tapered wedge connector with snap spheres

ui.custom_connector_desc.en: Use another mesh object from the scene as connector shape

ui.custom_connector_object_desc.en: Mesh object from this scene used as connector shape. Its local Z axis is treated as the insertion direction; it will be rescaled to the Width/Length/Depth values below.

ui.custom_connector_width_desc.en: Target size along the object's local X axis

ui.custom_connector_length_desc.en: Target size along the object's local Y axis

ui.custom_connector_depth_desc.en: Target size along the object's local Z axis (insertion depth)

op.connect.custom.err.no_object.en: Please select a connector object for Custom Connector.

op.connect.custom.err.empty_mesh.en: Selected connector object has no usable mesh data.

ui.dovetail_taper_pct_desc.en: Percentage by which the tip is narrower than the base

ui.dovetail_signed_taper_desc.en: Signed taper along insertion. Positive widens, negative narrows. If non-zero, overrides plain taper.

ui.dovetail_span_axis_desc.en: Auto stretches along the Dovetail Width axis and trims to the outer sides; X/Y/Z force overshoot along that world axis if it lies in the seam plane; None uses the manually configured Dovetail Length

ui.span_axis_none.en: Use the manually configured Dovetail Length; only trim edges if Hard-side Cut is enabled

ui.span_axis_auto.en: Automatically stretch along the Dovetail Width axis and trim to the outer sides

ui.span_axis_x.en: Force overshoot along world X, if it lies in the seam plane

ui.span_axis_y.en: Force overshoot along world Y, if it lies in the seam plane

ui.span_axis_z.en: Force overshoot along world Z, if it lies in the seam plane

ui.span_axis_hint.en: Forces hard-side cut along this axis.

ui.dovetail_hard_side_cut_desc.en: Prefer sharp side cut for dovetail socket/slot

ui.dovetail_margin_pct_desc.en: Trim percentage at both ends of seam span

ui.inplane_offset_u_mm_desc.en: Offset within the cut plane along the width (u) axis to shift the dovetail pattern

ui.inplane_offset_v_mm_desc.en: Offset within the cut plane along the length (v) axis to shift the dovetail pattern

ui.inplane_rotation_deg_desc.en: Rotation within the cut plane to orient the dovetail pattern

ui.dovetail_span_mode_desc.en: How the dovetail spans along the seam

ui.auto_span_tip.en: Use full edge-to-edge span of the seam

ui.connector_live_preview_desc.en: Show a live wireframe preview of connector placement (LINE/GRID) for the current selection. Capped at 200 preview objects for performance.

op.connect.preview.warn.cap.en: Connector live preview stopped at 200 objects; remaining points are not shown.

fstring_sites.template: Connector live preview stopped at {AUTOPREVIEW_CAP} objects; remaining points are not shown.

ui.distribution_desc.en: Distribute connectors along a line or a grid across the seam face

ui.line_desc.en: Place connectors along a line in the seam face

ui.grid_desc.en: Distribute connectors in a grid over the seam face

ui.rows_grid_desc.en: Number of rows for grid distribution

ui.margin_pct_desc.en: Edge margin along the seam (and perpendicular in GRID) as percentage of part length (0–40% recommended)

ui.spheres_per_side_desc.en: Number of snap spheres per side/around

ui.protrusion_mm_desc.en: How far spheres protrude from side surface

ui.insert_depth_pct_desc.en: Percentage of connector length recessed into part A

ui.material_profile_desc.en: Select a material profile to auto-fill tolerance per side

ui.tol_override_desc.en: Overrides material profile (0 = use profile value)

ui.pick_faces_hint.en: Pick faces in Object Mode (A = target, B = moving)

ERR_PICK_A_B_FIRST.en: Pick Face A and Face B first (Object Mode).

ERR_STORED_FACES_NOT_FOUND.en: Stored faces not found or not meshes.

HINT_RAYCAST_NO_FACE.en: No face hit. Orbit/zoom and click directly on a visible mesh.

op.connect.click.doc.en: Interactively place a connector (pin/tenon/dovetail) by clicking on the seam plane between two parts.

op.connect.batch.doc.en: Batch-place connectors between all adjacent selected parts using current settings.

op.connect.dovetail.warn.span_axis_not_i.en: Selected Span Axis matches the seam normal, not the seam plane; span axis ignored.

ui.custom_snap_spheres_enabled_desc.en: Add a ring of snap spheres around the Custom Connector, using Custom Width as the reference axis

ui.flush_barb_height_desc.en: Axial height of the shallow barb near the seam

ui.flush_barb_lip_desc.en: Radial/XY lip amount for the barb at the seam

ui.tolerance_hint.en: For tight fit, reduce tolerance; for easy assembly, increase.

ui.cap_seams_hint.en: To close existing seams, run 'Cap seams now'.

ui.high_part_count_slow.en: High part count may be slow
